Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses (A) DOCUMENTS REQUIRED FOR SUBMISSION 1) The bidder must have a GST Registration Certificate issued by a competent authority.

Note: The bidder should also have the latest filled Monthly/Quarterly GSTR 3B return as GST clearance, faili ng which the bidder's offer shall not be considered for further evaluation. 2) Copy of PAN issued by Competent Authority 3) Any document (LOI/WO/invoice, etc.) or any other document substantiating as proof of execution of a si milar type of job (i.e., hiring of vehicle) in any sector from the last 02 years of value not less than Rs. 7.29 l akh. (B) TERMS & CONDITIONS 1. Working Hours & Running KM Package 1.1 Normal Hours Up to 3000 km running per month and 26 days x 12 hours per duty including 1 hour lunch. 1.1 Overtime and extra running On a prorata basis 2. Maintenance, repair and other charges etc. All types of repairing provided by the successful bidder shall be done by him at his own cost. If there is an y repair / breakdown for more than 03 hours or in case of absence, the applicable amount shall be deducte d on a prorata basis from your bill. Any other charges related to things like RTO, insurance, tax, etc. will b e paid by the successful Bidder. 3. Log Book Log books shall be maintained to record the operation time and shall be signed by B and R’s authorised re presentative. The bill shall be made on the basis of record in the logbook. 4. Safety Rule A successful bidder has to follow all safety precautions as imposed by our client from time to time. The ve hicle should have a spark arrestor to enter inside the premises of our client, M/s. HPCL, and the same is in the bidder's scope. 5. Security of Vehicle Security of the vehicle deployed at the site will be in the bidder's scope; nothing will be charged to B AND R on this account under any circumstances whatsoever. 6. Right to accept or reject the offer B and R shall always reserve the right to accept or cancel any or all the offers without assigning any reaso ns whatsoever. 7. Contract Period The contract may be extended beyond the stipulated time or may be terminated before the stipulated con tract period with a 15-day notice period. 8. In case of any accident with the vehicle, it will be the responsibility of the bidders or his representative t o lodge an FIR, etc., with the police. All RTO issues and traffic violations are to the account of the successfu l bidder. In such cases, the driver's responsibility, if any, shall be taken care of by bidders only. 9. Driver and vehicle should not be changed frequently. In case of any unavoidable circumstances, the bid der can change the driver/vehicle if required, but compulsory prior intimation should be given to the user c oncerned. 10. Price The rate quoted shall remain firm without any escalation on any account till the completion of the job and the order is executed in all respects. 11. Driver

The driver shall be supplied by the bidder. His payment shall also be under the bidder's scope. The driver s alary shall be paid as per the government minimum wages along with the necessary PF/ESIC as per the go vernment rules. The bidder shall submit the driver's valid documents required to the owner for making gat e passes. Whenever the main driver is on leave, the bidder needs to arrange a proper alternate driver with out any extra cost to the owner. If the vehicle is not available due to the driver being absent, then the sam e day will be treated as no work, no pay for both the driver and vehicle hire charges. 12. The required vehicle should be in good running condition. In case the condition of the vehicle is not fou nd to be satisfactory, the same shall be returned for immediate replacement as per the instruction of the e ngineer-in-charge. 13. The mileage & time reckoning shall be from the pickup location and close at the drop location. 14. Contract may be extended beyond the stipulated time or may be terminated before the stipulated cont ract period with a 15-day notice period. 15. Billing Address: Bridge and Roof Company (India) Limited, Office No.401-408, Kukreja Centre B-Wing, 4th Floor, Plot No.13, Sector-11, CBD Belapur, Navi Mumbai-400614, Thane, Maharashtra GSTIN: 27AABCB3166E1ZZ; State Code: 27 .
